reason: Batch 003 source audit corrected the wrong Group D storage premise. PD 1096 classifies Group D as Institutional and Group G as Storage and Hazardous; RA 9514 supplies protected-exit and special-hazard rules.

proposed.text: A paint storage room has a hazard greater than normal office occupancy. Which source-backed protection path should the architect check first?

options.text: Treat it as Group D storage and use a 2-hour rule
Apply the RA 9514 special-hazard rule: at least four-hour fire resistance, automatic fire protection, or both; high hazard requires both

proposed.rationale: RA 9514 Section 10.2.6.10(A) controls hazards greater than normal occupancy.
proposed.explanation: The old concrete-block typical-rating claim was not verified in local raw sources.
proposed.code_citation: RA 9514 2019 RIRR Section 10.2.6.10(A); PD 1096 Rule VII Group G
